assets.name: rail-cart
assets.wheelRotationAxis: Physical axle is cart-local Z. Existing procedural wheel geometry uses native Y, rest EulerX=pi/2, and animated EulerY. Choose and document node basis before wiring GLB animation.
assets.includedStaticLoad: Steel coil in a separate hideable load-coil node; stationary relative to wagon while loaded, not fused with chassis.
assets.integrationNote: Four-wheel geometry and axle clearance must be verified, not inferred from three visible wheels in concept.

loadVisibility.requirement: Attach/reparent separated coil to runtime bed with its transform preserved. Toggle only the load; keep chassis/wheels visible. Existing whole-model coil must not stay baked into chassis.

assets.normalizationCaution: Current wheels have minimum cart-localY0.02. model() normalizes complete mesh minY to0; compare fitted wheel centres and rail contact after normalization rather than blindly retaining the raw0.17 pivotY. Exact placement adapter belongs to integration.

assets.name: shaft-motor
assets.integrationNote: Reference is appearance only. Place bore at contract anchor when producing actual mesh.
clearanceRequirements: Keep through-bore open over body height at model-localXZ(0,-0.25) when the body is placed at partZ=-0.1.
Bore radius must exceed actual shaft radius0.08; recommended modeling allowance radius0.10, subject to actual mesh measurement.
No static cover in the shaft or rotating-collar volume. Future target body height0.25 differs from current0.24; confirm top/bearing clearance after fitting.

assets.name: socket-board
assets.integrationNote: Socket signs are face texture. Active six-terminal layout stays in runtime code. Verify overall feet bounding box separately.
clearanceRequirements: Keep front(+Z) access to all six shaped terminals and two inputs; painted3signs do not replace electrical terminals.
FACTORY-KIT target and current fallback dimensions differ. Record panel and overall frame/feet bbox separately; do not normalize whole asset to panel width without measuring feet/frame.
Keep feet short and behind active terminal rows; actual placement is integration work.

coordinateFrames.part: Game part local frame: +X right/travel, +Y up, +Z front/south. All baseline coordinates below include PLATE_TOP where stated.
coordinateFrames.modelHelper: src/parts/assets.ts model(): rotateY, then uniform fit on one chosen axis, then baseY=0 and XZ bbox centre=0. Do not assume fitting width enforces height/depth.
coordinateFrames.status: Measured code baseline and proposed GLB requirements, not verified GLB geometry.
